exposure: Two doses of the mRNA SARS-CoV-2 BNT162b2 vaccine
outcome: Serologic response to SARS-CoV-2 BNT162b2 vaccine
cohort: The study included 139 women: 36 pregnant with IBD, 61 pregnant without IBD, and 42 not pregnant with IBD.
finding: All women with IBD mounted a serologic response to the SARS-CoV-2 BNT162b2 vaccine, and the interval between vaccine administration and serology assessment was the most important factor determining antibody levels.
gest_age: Mean gestational ages at administration of the second vaccine doses were 22.0 weeks in IBD and 23.2 weeks in non-IBD groups.
